entities.summary: Qamruddin Ahmad Gorakhpuri was an Indian Islamic scholar, Hadith professor, and Sheikh. He served as a teacher at Darul Uloom Deoband from 1966 until his death in 2024. He was an authorized disciple of Abrarul Haq Haqqi in Sufism.
